topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: According to the Department of Licensing, how many continuing education hours must an active managing broker complete per two-year renewal cycle?
explanation: Active managing broker licenses require 30 continuing education hours per two-year renewal cycle -- distinct from the 90-hour qualifying education needed before the original managing broker exam.
source_note: DOL: Renew or reinstate your license - Real estate managing brokers

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: According to the Department of Licensing, which specific 3-hour course is required as part of every managing broker license renewal?
choice_c: Current Issues in Washington Residential Real Estate Course
explanation: Every active renewal must include the 3-hour Current Issues in Washington Residential Real Estate Course, with the remaining hours coming from other approved continuing education.
source_note: DOL: Renew or reinstate your license - Real estate managing brokers

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: Of the 30 total continuing education hours required per renewal cycle, how many hours must come from other approved continuing education besides the 3-hour required course?
explanation: After the required 3-hour Current Issues course, at least 27 hours must come from other approved continuing education to reach the 30-hour total.
source_note: DOL: Renew or reinstate your license - Real estate managing brokers

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: According to the Department of Licensing, at least how many of the 30 required continuing education hours must be completed within 24 months of the renewal date?
explanation: At least 15 of the 30 required hours must be completed within 24 months of the renewal date; up to 15 additional hours completed within 48 months (and not previously used) may also count.
source_note: DOL: Renew or reinstate your license - Real estate managing brokers

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: According to the Department of Licensing, up to how many continuing education hours completed within 48 months of the renewal date may be counted toward renewal, provided they were not already used for a previous renewal?
explanation: Up to 15 hours of continuing education completed within 48 months of the renewal date may be counted, as long as those hours were not already used to qualify for an earlier renewal.
source_note: DOL: Renew or reinstate your license - Real estate managing brokers

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: According to the Department of Licensing, continuing education hours counted toward a managing broker's renewal must have been completed when, relative to license issuance?
choice_a: There is no timing restriction relative to issuance
choice_b: At any time, even before the managing broker license was issued
choice_c: Only after the managing broker license was issued
choice_d: Only during the applicant's original broker licensure period
explanation: Continuing education courses counted toward a managing broker renewal must be started after the managing broker license was issued; pre-licensure coursework does not count toward renewal.
source_note: DOL: Renew or reinstate your license - Real estate managing brokers

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: According to the Department of Licensing, how many hours of Washington Real Estate Fair Housing coursework must a managing broker complete with each active license renewal, once the initial fair housing course has already been taken?
explanation: Once the initial 6-hour Washington Real Estate Fair Housing course has been completed, each subsequent active renewal requires a 3-hour Washington Real Estate Fair Housing course.
source_note: DOL: Renew or reinstate your license - Real estate managing brokers

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: According to the Department of Licensing, is continuing education required to renew an inactive managing broker license?
choice_a: Only if the license has been inactive for more than one renewal cycle
choice_b: Yes, the full 30-hour requirement still applies
choice_c: No continuing education is required to renew an inactive license
choice_d: Only the fair housing portion is required
explanation: No continuing education hours are needed to renew a managing broker license that is being kept on inactive status.
source_note: DOL: Renew or reinstate your license - Real estate managing brokers

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: According to the Department of Licensing, a managing broker whose license has been canceled may reinstate it if the cancellation was how recent, and what happens if it has been expired even longer?
choice_a: Reinstatement is available only within 30 days of cancellation
choice_b: Reinstatement is never available once a license lapses
choice_c: Reinstatement is available if canceled less than 2 years ago; if expired more than 3 years, a new license application is required
choice_d: Reinstatement is always available regardless of how long the license has been expired
explanation: A license canceled less than 2 years ago is eligible for reinstatement; once a license has been expired for more than 3 years, the individual must apply as a new applicant instead.
source_note: DOL: Renew or reinstate your license - Real estate managing brokers

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: According to the Department of Licensing, how many clock hours of approved real estate coursework are required to reinstate an expired managing broker license, and what course must make up half of it?
choice_a: 10 clock hours, with no specific course required
choice_b: 30 clock hours, with 15 hours in the Advanced Practices Course
choice_c: 60 clock hours, with 30 of those hours in the Real Estate Law course
choice_d: 90 clock hours, with 45 hours in the Brokerage Management course
explanation: Reinstating an expired managing broker license requires 60 clock hours of approved coursework, 30 of which must include the Real Estate Law course.
source_note: DOL: Renew or reinstate your license - Real estate managing brokers

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: According to the Department of Licensing, besides back renewal fees, what specific penalty fine applies to reinstating an expired managing broker license?
explanation: In addition to all back renewal fees with penalties, a $100 reinstatement penalty fine applies when reinstating an expired managing broker license.
source_note: DOL: Renew or reinstate your license - Real estate managing brokers

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: How does the 90-hour educational requirement in RCW 18.85.111 differ from the 30-hour continuing education requirement described on the Department of Licensing's managing broker renewal page?
choice_a: The 90 hours applies only to designated brokers, while the 30 hours applies only to branch managers
choice_b: The 90 hours is required only for reinstatement, never for a new applicant
choice_c: They are the same requirement, just described on two different pages
choice_d: The 90 hours qualifies an applicant to sit for the managing broker exam before initial licensure; the 30 hours is the ongoing continuing education required every two years after licensure
explanation: The 90-hour requirement (30 hours each in brokerage management, business management, and advanced real estate law) is pre-licensure qualifying education for the managing broker exam, while the 30-hour continuing education requirement recurs every two-year renewal cycle after the license is issued.
source_note: RCW 18.85.111(1)(d); DOL managing broker renewal page

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: Under WAC 308-124C-125, when notifying parties to pending transactions that the firm is closing, what two outcomes must the designated broker's notice describe for how those transactions will be handled?
choice_a: That all pending transactions are automatically canceled with no further recourse
choice_b: That the client must immediately hire a new, unrelated firm within 24 hours
choice_c: That the department of licensing will personally complete the transaction
choice_d: That the firm will either transfer the transaction documents with written authorization, or ensure the transaction is completed without any new licensable activity by the closing firm
explanation: As part of firm closure procedures, the designated broker must notify all parties to pending transactions within 5 business days, informing them that the firm is closing and how their transaction will be handled.

topic: WA Managing Broker: License Renewal, Continuing Education & Firm Closure
question: Under RCW 18.85.211, which continuing education topic requirement applies equally to both brokers and managing brokers renewing an active license, requiring 3 of the 30 hours (or 6 hours if the initial training was not previously completed)?
choice_d: Fair housing education and prevention of unfair practices
explanation: RCW 18.85.211(2) requires 3 of the 30 renewal hours to focus on fair housing education and prevention of unfair practices, rising to 6 hours for renewal applicants who had not previously completed that training, for both brokers and managing brokers alike.
